duration.text: The Motor Ship Engine Engineering at Tianjin University of Technology is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2277 USD/In total ￥ 16400 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1.18 to 60 years of age 2.International Applicants should be an HSK 4 holder. Those without a HSK certificate should come and take an entrance examination of Comprehensive Chinese one week before the new semester begins. Those who fail the entrance exam may take the Chinese course before they retake the Exam.
